title: Mall World Warehouse
content: Ok this is my first post so be nice please. So I have had a few dreams about this place. Two different ones but they have both repeated. Both are dark at night. The first is a pool party that I'm worried about sharks coming from, but during the party catfish come from the pool and can change into humans and they are attacking people so we scatter. Some of us go inside and it looks almost like stone/concrete and there's a bunch of hallways and rooms and we are being chased and trying to hide. The other is there is a door at the very top of the warehouse and I and a few others escape out of it and run down the very long steep metal staircase out into this long grassy area. There is a chainlink fence and on the other side is more grass, a beach, and an ocean with a ship that's waiting for us, but we never reach it or the beach no matter how far we get. I put together a pic of what I see from the back. Just think in the front is a pool like a community pool at a hotel. Does anyone else know this place?
